summary: Frontend adds an admin-only User Management page/route, role-based navigation, and English guidance that roles are assigned by an administrator. However, the diff summary does not show the required backend role-promotion API implementation (and persistence/target-existence checks) needed for role changes to actually take effect.

missing_requirements.requirement: Backend admin-only method to promote/demote (or set) another user’s effective authorization role (user/admin), rejecting anonymous and non-admin callers with clear Unauthorized errors; changes must persist; error if target user does not exist/has never been seen.
missing_requirements.reason: Frontend calls/assumes backend methods like getCallerUserRole and role-assignment + listing users, but the backend/main.mo diff excerpt does not show any new shared method that changes roles or lists users, nor any persistence/target-existence validation logic for role changes.
